classes: No class or race field in any packet read. player.js carries spriteId (int16, line 19), an appearance index, not a class.
Factions: charinfo.js line 13 carries a pledge string (clan tag) next to name; chat.html line 11 has a Clan tab. The only faction-like data.
Progression: none in the client files.
zones: None. tiles.js draws a grid of tile sprites at tileSize 32 (game_controller.js line 22; tiles.js line 42); no zone, biome or spawn data in the donor.

looks.label: Hover texture swap on a tile
looks.technique: Pointer-over state by changing a sprite's texture between normal and hover textures; no animation needed.

looks.label: One tile unit shared by camera and tiles
looks.technique: A 32 px grid constant: sprite placed at centre plus tile offset times 32.

looks.label: Hover-to-identify
looks.technique: Mouseover handler on a character sprite writes the name to the console; no visible panel in the client read.

looks.label: Render loop only
looks.technique: requestAnimationFrame is the only loop found; no idle animation, sound, death, respawn, boss or loot code in the client read.

originals.name: Fight Camera
originals.idea: Fixed hero at screen centre with the world offset per tile; widens its frame toward a foe in range.
originals.keep: Fixed hero and offset world (parity row 11).
originals.change: Add smoothing (the move hook is an empty stub) and a fight framing.

originals.name: Screen Stack
originals.idea: One stack of screens for login, character select and world, with push, current and a working pop.
originals.keep: One stack with push and current.
originals.change: Working pop using splice; our screens; a fade between them.

originals.name: Clan-Tag Chat
originals.idea: Chat with a default tab and per-tab history, plus a read-only fight-log tab.
originals.change: Our channel names, colour tags, and the fight log.

originals.name: Pledge Tag
originals.idea: A short clan string shown on the character card.
originals.keep: A short clan string on the character info.
originals.change: Our tag rules and its look.

originals.name: Ready Gate
originals.idea: Asset loading that reports ready when the pending list empties.
originals.keep: Ready when the pending list is empty.
originals.change: Guard unknown items: return false when the index is below zero (the donor's splice(-1, 1) removes the last item).

originals.name: Compact Move Record
originals.idea: One short fixed-field record per moving actor for many-on-one sync (parity row 18, post-K item 3).
originals.keep: Short fixed-field record per actor, one per move.
originals.change: Our field set and a rate limit.
